description: Defines the HpackWholeEntryBuffer class, which manages buffering and decoding of HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, handling entries that may be split across multiple buffers. It includes methods for setting listeners, buffer size limits, and handling decoding callbacks.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
classes.description: Manages buffering and decoding of a complete HPACK header entry, supporting entries split across multiple buffers, with configurable size limits and error handling.

methods.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a listener and maximum string size.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener to be notified when a header entry is decoded.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for strings accepted from the wire.

methods.name: BufferStringsIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Ensures decoded strings are buffered to allow transport buffer reuse.

methods.name: error_detected
methods.description: Returns whether an error has been detected during decoding.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Handles start of a literal header.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Handles start of header name data.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Handles start of header value data.
